about: 10-research-systems v0.35: round re-lock suite. Written BEFORE the f606801 run. Read by relock_suite_job.ps1 (what to boot) and relock_eval.py (how to judge). Seeds: make_mid = r01-r05 cleared (3/3/2/3/1) with real record_result, unlocked 6, melee L2 + fast L2 bought; make_complete = r01-r10 cleared, unlocked 11; make_new = saved before any clear, unlocked 1; make_incons = unlocked 6 with stars only r01,r02 (not reachable by play); none = no save file; relocked = the f606801 result of M_insert2 (fixed file in the evidence folder once made). Each step = variants applied to a fresh copy of the base snapshot; steps of one case boot the same private user folder in order with no play in between. must_open / must_locked are checked after the LAST step; the generic criteria after EVERY step.

criteria.U1: every round of the new order that has a star record is playable
criteria.U2: every round that was playable before the step (old order from content_snapshot.order cut at unlocked_round, mapped by round_renames) and still exists is playable
criteria.U3: no skip: a round of the old order that was locked before stays locked unless its predecessor in the new order is cleared (new rounds are not constrained: 01 decides)
criteria.U4: only for cases with no_write: the save file bytes do not change and no pre-migration backup is created
criteria.U5: no upgrade already bought (level > 1) becomes locked
criteria.U6: INFO only (02 decides): a save already re-locked by f606801, booted with the SAME data (same content_version), is repaired or not

cases.predict_f606801: FAIL U1 U2 U5 must_open (step 2; step 3 does not repair)
